validationLevels.name: Discovered
validationLevels.description: The project was located, but its source and runtime behavior have not been reviewed.

validationLevels.name: Source reviewed
validationLevels.description: Package metadata, composition files, lifecycle scripts, permissions, and obvious risks were reviewed.

validationLevels.name: Import compatible
validationLevels.description: Static dependency analysis and a real host-entry import probe passed in the named environment.

validationLevels.name: Composition mounted
validationLevels.description: An isolated DSH profile started with all expected Cordis rows active and tools registered.

validationLevels.name: Functional smoke
validationLevels.description: At least one representative end-to-end capability completed successfully in a controlled target.

validationLevels.name: Deployment validated
validationLevels.description: Exact source or artifact identity, acceptance checks, security notes, and rollback steps are recorded.

validationLevels.name: Locked baseline
validationLevels.description: The exact component is part of a maintained deployment lock and its complete acceptance contract.

evidence.description: The Windows Copilot deployment lock pins official Desktop 0.10.2, its seven Profile links, and its non-bundled panel placeholder together with the Copilot artifact, source commit, build commands, and required capabilities.
The maintained web and headless Profiles completed real host-entry import probes without fatal imports.
The validated Profiles loaded the expected plugin composition and registered the supported capabilities.

The rc.2 Desktop client ModuleLoader handoff, strict remote result codecs, strict JSON OAuth grant normalization, built-in pi-ai OAuth, authorization-service bootstrap, existing-grant route self-heal, account-available mixed-protocol per-model API routing, Copilot-scoped removal of unusable escalation properties while other providers retain native schemas, direct Copilot hosted search, Desktop authorization UI, and fail-closed compatibility acceptance are documented.

notes: Model prompts, images, and hosted-search queries are sent directly to GitHub Copilot by DSH's built-in pi-ai adapter and this plugin.
The shared DSH credential record owns OAuth refresh; the plugin normalizes provider-owned grant fields to strict JSON, and deployment checks report only record metadata, never payload values.
Hosted search does not add a separate local approval prompt, gateway process, or ACP integration.

plugins.summary: The locked standalone DSH plugin with the rc.2 Desktop client ModuleLoader handoff, strict remote result codecs, strict JSON OAuth grant normalization, built-in pi-ai Copilot authorization, existing-grant route self-heal, complete mixed-protocol per-model API routes, provider-scoped removal of unusable Copilot escalation properties, and direct provider-hosted search; no embedded gateway or ACP scope.

evidence.description: The Host-wide shared-process and isolated-browser boundaries are reviewed and documented.
Static bundle tests verify the package and composed MCP markers before activation.
The Web profile resolves one Host-scope Playwright MCP using the immutable source commit, isolated Microsoft Edge, and pinned MCP version.
Host MCP navigated the existing DSH GUI, captured accessibility state, and inspected browser requests after activation.

notes: Uses an isolated Edge profile but one Host-owned MCP process is shared across Sessions.
Browser tools can navigate to external sites and submit user-directed data; isolation does not prevent network transmission.
Optional Web overlay; not required by the Windows Copilot deployment lock.

plugins.summary: Optional Host-wide Playwright MCP bundle for isolated Edge testing of the existing DSH GUI.

evidence.description: The scheduler lifecycle, persistence, cold wake, and Windows notification limitation are reviewed.
The installed Host entry loads and publishes cron tools in the active Web profile.
The Web profile mounts the immutable v0.3.3 source and publishes its cron tools.
cron_list completed successfully against the active Web profile.

notes: Scheduled prompts are sent to the configured external LLM when tasks fire.
Scheduled prompts resume only their owning Session and persist task/history files under DSH_HOME.
Windows native system notifications are not implemented and configured systemNotify flags are quiet no-ops.
Optional Web overlay; not required by the Windows Copilot deployment lock.

plugins.summary: Optional Web-profile scheduler with Session-bound cold wake, cron tools, and persisted run history.

evidence.description: Offline-first release resolution and bounded fetch behavior were merged upstream in PR #586.
The earlier launcher network stall and DSH startup impact are documented.

notes: Run MCP servers read-only until write operations are explicitly needed.
Not installed by the locked Windows Copilot deployment.

plugins.summary: A historically investigated Windows desktop-control MCP; the repository records a launcher reliability fix, not current functional certification.
notes: Must pass current source review, import checks, isolated composition mount, and functional smoke before recommendation.

evidence.description: Model-aware admission and neutral prompting are recorded in the optional integration PR.
The dual-channel design and limitations are documented locally.

notes: Images may be sent to the configured vision provider.
Not installed by the locked Windows Copilot deployment.

plugins.summary: An optional vision-tool fallback design for text-only routes; it remains outside the locked baseline.

evidence.description: The rc.1 subprocess, cancellation, lossless JSON, canonical-path, consequential-operation, and Fiber-owned lifecycle requirements are documented with the source.

The plugin registers five tools in a real rc.1 Cordis/ToolRuntime harness, uses the subprocess service with whole-tree quiescence, returns only lossless JSON values, and unregisters every contribution on Fiber disposal.
The exact official rc.1 ToolRunContext source and commit are checked before compatibility is claimed.

notes: Provides development, patching, build, upgrade, and doctor operations; use only in trusted maintenance sessions.
Approval behavior is deployment policy rather than a guarantee of this plugin; configure standing permissions before consequential calls.
The dsh_upgrade check operation queries the configured Git remote; other managed subprocesses act on local operator-selected paths.

plugins.summary: Repository-local agent tools for DSH development and maintenance, suitable for trusted operator sessions.
